entries.subject: NASA VTAD 55 Cnc e 3D model texture as an illustration lens
entries.finding: Shown as the non-default Illustration lens, never as imagery: the base-colour texture of NASA's 55 Cnc e 3D Model (55_Cancri_e_1_24364.glb), carried through the model's own UVs onto the sphere, unrepainted, with arbitrary longitudes. No image resolves this planet; nothing in the texture was observed. The resource page gives the credit and a one-line description; it does not say how the texture was made.
